title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Oil-spike tape, tech faded, defensives bid. Brent +4% to $82.70 on Hormuz threats flipped the session from pre-market gains to a down close; airlines -3.1% and memory chips dragged while energy-services rallied. The market absorbed a geopolitical shock via sector rotation, not beta liquidation.

INDICES — VIX 15.2, down 0.7%. SOXX +0.34%, SPY -0.16%, QQQ -0.37%, IWM -0.51%, DIA -0.85%. Small > large by 0.35pp. USO +3.47% was the standout cross-asset move; TLT -0.58% on higher yields. Neither SPY nor QQQ below 200-day.

VOLUME — SPY vol 0.9x, QQQ 0.8x — both light, confirming low-conviction drift. GLD at 1.7x and XLU 1.5x show money rotating into havens with volume; XLK 0.8x and XLY 0.6x signal distribution-through-inaction in cyclicals.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE +1.48%, XLC +0.28%, XLV +0.18%, XLP -0.26%, XLK -0.31%, XLF -0.33%, XLY -0.46%, XLU -0.64%, XLI -0.85%, XLRE -0.86%, XLB -0.89%. Top industries: MSOS +7.67%, USO +3.47%; bottom: DRAM -4.28%, WGMI -3.52%. Money out of chips and homebuilders into oil and gold; energy-led defensive bid. Rotation state: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.25 shows heavy protection demand; QQQ skew +7.2% confirms elevated put premium. QQQ GEX flip 728 vs spot ~703 — price below flip, dealer hedging amplifies downside. VIX 15.2 below 20-day 17.2; MOVE 76.1 above 20-day 70 signals bond vol stress.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +3.47% vs JETS -2.65% is the clean transmission: Hormuz risk priced into crude, hammering airlines via fuel costs. Dollar +0.36% alongside gold flat — the reserve bid offsetting typical inverse dollar-gold.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 65.8 Greed. Movers: PH +7.31% on PSEi GDP-wait dip; ALB +5.54% on Q2 sales up 31% to $1.7B; UPS -4.18% despite raised guidance to $91.2B — digital-tool rollout underwhelmed. Watch: DRAM -4.28% on 2.2x vol spike — memory distribution after WDC/SanDisk guidance; FDN -1.36% at 2.2x volume — tech-breadth fade; ALB +5.54% on 2.0x vol — lithium momentum with no news, pure flow.
